chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"When you have finished the prayer, turn away to your right."
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended direction to turn after finishing the prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* via the chain of Sama’ah, this hadith specifies the recommended etiquette (adab) for concluding the prayer by turning to the right, a practice often linked to the general Sunnah of starting and ending actions with the right side. While some scholars debate whether this turning is a distinct post-prayer act or part of the final Tashahhud, it underscores the importance of maintaining dignified physical conduct even after the ritual obligations are fulfilled. This specific instruction highlights the Shia emphasis on detailed adherence to the Prophet’s and Imams’ practical demonstrations of worship.
